defects.title: A commit count that git cannot compute stops the function with an undefined variable instead of the intended warning
defects.trigger: updateCobraToolbox(true) in a clone whose remote.origin.url contains opencobra/cobratoolbox, on a branch, with a local master, where 'git rev-list --left-right --count master...origin/master' fails (e.g. origin/master never fetched); reproduced with a stand-in git executable first on PATH
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-15) "Unrecognized function or variable 'commitsAheadBehindMaster'." at line 85 (counts assigned only when rev-list succeeds, lines 56-58); with master 0/0 and a failing develop count: 'commitsAheadBehindDevelop' at line 85; lines 157-158 reachable only when master is ahead
defects.expected: message of line 157 and the warning 'Eventual changes of the <master> branch ... could not be counted.' (lines 157-158)

notes: Reproduction (no network, repository untouched): put an executable 'git' shell script first on PATH (setenv) in a tempname folder that answers each command from files: rev-list --max-count=1 HEAD -> 'abcdef1234567890', rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD -> 'develop', config --get remote.origin.url -> 'https://github.com/opencobra/cobratoolbox.git', symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD -> 'develop', fetch origin -> status 0, show-ref ... master/develop -> 0, rev-list --left-right --count master...origin/master -> 'fatal: bad revision', status 128, develop count -> '0\t3'; then updateCobraToolbox(true) -> error above. The same stand-in with both counts succeeding (0 2 / 0 3) ran to 'You can update The COBRA Toolbox by running updateCobraToolbox()' and logged only read-only commands (rev-list, rev-parse, config, symbolic-ref, fetch, show-ref, status), so a later test can use it. Also seen (not recorded as separate defects): lines 85-86 print 'already up-to-date' when a local branch is ahead; lines 99-140 need interactive input(); lines 172-185 add/remove sibling fork-* folders of the toolbox on the path (a test must stand in for initCobraToolbox and restore the path). No src caller (only tutorials mention it), so the quarantine blocks nothing.
confirmed_by: lead (writer's reproduction with a stand-in git, no network: when git cannot count commits, line 85 reads an undefined variable)

defects.title: The documented output IDAdded is not assigned when nothing is added, so a call requesting it stops
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-15) 'Output argument "IDAdded" (and possibly others) not assigned a value in the execution with "addInfoFromMolFiles" function.' IDAdded is assigned only in the adding branches (64-66, 82-84, 96-98), never initialised (line 46 sets only cnt)
defects.expected: IDAdded returned empty when nothing is added

notes: Reproduction: the trigger above (also with the default folder 'ctf-main/mets/molFiles', which does not exist). Quarantine reach: confined to the two-output call form; src callers list2MetaboliteStructure (line 174) and createrBioNetStructure (line 115) request only metabolite_structure, so they do not reach it. Even unquarantined, lines 56-69, 75-85, 89-98 need Open Babel (line 56 calls obabel directly; 76, 90 via convertInchiString2format) and would be exempt; only the no-conversion paths are testable here.
confirmed_by: lead (writer's MATLAB reproduction: the IDAdded output is never assigned when nothing is added)

notes: Hand-built Metabolites/Reactions_AGORA2_refined.xlsx and two Recon3D_Dec2017.mat files (different contents) in tempname folders, each with an empty tutorial_MetaboAnnotator.m so which() returns the current folder: folder 1 has data/Recon3D_Dec2017.mat (line 53), folder 2 has the MAT file itself (line 55); no path change. Checks Agora2/Recon3D flags and '<file>:automatic:' sources, compartment suffix stripped for mets, reaction = 1 with Reactions file and Recon3D.rxns, nothing added for unmatched Recon3D ids. Exempt 84-108: dead code (hit is non-empty only for VMHIds of the structure itself, so isfield at line 76 is always true); 118-141: dead code ('elseif 0', line 112). addField2MetStructure/addField2RxnStructure are called only from those dead lines. The shipped files (tutorials submodule) are not used.

defects.title: A row whose VMH id is not in the structure overwrites the metabolite of the previous matched row
defects.trigger: table rows {35,'KEY1','InChI=1S/H2O/h1H2',...,'h2o'} then {50,'KEY2','InChI=X',...,'notInStruct'} (headers CHEM_ID, INCHIKEY, INCHISTRING, CAS, CHEMSPIDER, HMDB, KEGG, PUBCHEM, VMH ID); VMH2Metabolon(struct('VMH_h2o', struct('VMHId','h2o','metNames','Water')))
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-15) VMH_h2o.metabolon = 50, inchiKey = 'KEY2', inchiString = 'InChI=X' (all identifiers of row 2): vmhId is not cleared when no metabolite matches (line 54), so line 58 writes the row into the previous match
defects.expected: VMH_h2o keeps metabolon 35 / KEY1; unmatched rows change nothing

defects.title: A table whose first row with a VMH id has no matching metabolite stops the function
defects.trigger: the same table with the two rows swapped, or the shipped table (first row 1pyr5c) with a structure holding only h2o
defects.expected: the row is skipped, later matching rows copied

defects.title: A comma-separated VMH id that is not in the structure stops the function
defects.trigger: a table row with VMH ID 'h2o,zzz' and a structure holding only h2o
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-15) 'Unable to perform assignment with 0 elements on the right-hand side.' (line 47)
defects.expected: the ids found receive the row, the others are skipped

notes: Reproduction: writecell the table into a tempname folder, cd there (xlsread finds it before the tutorials copy) and call VMH2Metabolon as in the triggers; with the shipped table (tutorials/dataIntegration/metaboAnnotator/data, read from an empty folder) VMH2Metabolon(struct('VMH_h2o', struct('VMHId','h2o','metNames','Water'))) errors the same way at line 58. Only src caller createrBioNetStructure (EXCLUDED).
confirmed_by: lead (writer's MATLAB reproductions: an unmatched row overwrites the previous match; an unmatched first row and a missing comma-separated id error)

defects.title: A blank SEED cell overwrites the SEED id with NaN and writes a source
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-15) seed = NaN, seed_source = 'MetaboliteTranslationTable.xlsx:manual:<date>' (xlsread gives NaN for the blank cell; line 39 tests only isempty); the shipped table has no blank SEED cell
defects.expected: a blank SEED cell leaves the metabolite unchanged

notes: Hand-built table in a tempname folder (cwd), as testGetSeed2Kegg: added, overwritten, not listed, blank VMH cell and unknown VMH id rows; plus the shipped table (h2o -> cpd00001) when the tutorials submodule is on the path (it was here), else skipped with a message. Cosmetic precedent: wave09-b 'An empty field receives NaN with a source when the table cell is NaN'.

defects.title: The metabolite counter is printed for every metabolite
defects.trigger: any call with a non-empty metabolite structure
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-15) 'i =' and the index printed once per metabolite (line 40 has no semicolon)
defects.expected: no console output, or output gated behind a printLevel

notes: Only the no-conversion paths: complete metabolite (with VMHId), NaN and empty InChI string (without VMHId field, lines 31-33); IDsAdded stays '' and cleanUpMetabolite_structure (tested, runs for every input) is shown to run (KEGG spaces removed, PubChem/charge text -> numbers). Exempt 44-52, 56-64: Open Babel via convertInchiString2format (not available from MATLAB). Suspected, not confirmable without Open Babel: line 46/58 contains(result,'Error') errors ('First argument must be text') when convertInchiString2format returns NaN (its 'Missing or unknown output file' case), and with obabel absent the shell message (no 'Error') would be stored as inchiKey/smile (callee limitation noted in wave 09).

defects.title: An exchange list with fewer rows than columns stops the function
defects.trigger: R.s1.Ex_RxnsAdded = {'EX_a'; 'EX_b'}; R.s1.MinMaxAddedRxns = [0 1; -1 0]; R.s2.Ex_RxnsAdded = {'EX_b'}; R.s2.MinMaxAddedRxns = [-1 0]; mkTableOfAddedExchanges(R, {'s1','s2'}, statisticsAddedExchanges(R, {'s1','s2'})) (a 2 x 4 list)
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-15) 'Unable to perform assignment because the size of the left side is 4-by-1 and the size of the right side is 2-by-1.' (line 20): line 19 sizes the table by length(), the larger of rows and columns
defects.expected: a 2 x 3 table, one row per exchange

notes: Reproduction: the trigger above. A 1 x 3 list is silently expanded instead (Added_all(:,1) = scalar cell fills all 3 rows), then errors at line 29 for exchanges not listed. With at least as many rows as columns it works (5 x 5 list probed: one row per exchange, sample cells hold 1x1 cells, absent ones [] or {}). No src callers.
confirmed_by: lead (source read: Added_all sized with length(Ex_added_all_unique), line 19, which is the column count when there are fewer rows than columns)

defects.title: The table is not ordered by frequency as documented; the sorted copy goes to a differently spelled variable
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-15) rows {'EX_a',1,'secretion',[]} then {'EX_b',2,[],'uptake'} (order of unique): lines 74 and 76 assign to EX_added_all_unique, the output is Ex_added_all_unique; sortrows(output,-2) gives the documented order

defects.title: The sample counter is printed for every sample
defects.trigger: any call with at least one sample
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-15) 'i =' and the index printed once per sample (line 32 has no semicolon)
defects.expected: no console output, or output gated behind a printLevel

notes: Reproduction: the trigger above, compare with sortrows(out, -2). No src callers. Fix candidate is a one-letter case change at line 76 (plus dropping line 74), a separate spec-driven change.
confirmed_by: lead (source read: line 76 sorts Ex_added_all_unique, not the frequency table built in EX_added_all_unique on line 74)

notes: Noise-free Gaussian (a1 0.05, b1 -0.8, c1 2.2 on 100 points) recovered to 1e-4 relative, sse < 1e-10, rsquare 1, dfe 97, gof fields, fitresult.f; row and column inputs give identical coefficients. Run-time callee for every input (already tested): cobraFitGauss1.

Run-time callee for every input (already tested): cobraFitGauss1.
